# SimulatorArena Math: answer-order sensitivity in Manager-v0

On 50 real human–AI math tutoring dialogues, Manager-v0 changed its binary prediction when labels A/B were swapped in 49 cases. Order-averaged accuracy 52%, Brier .248629 vs disjoint prior .248097. Two identical runs, 200 total forward examples. Independent audit, not official simulator rollout. No neural training, product integration or promotion.

[Research evidence](https://github.com/Daisuke134/anicca-ops/pull/775) · [Remaining execution](https://github.com/Daisuke134/anicca-ops/issues/773)

Sources: [SimulatorArena paper](https://aclanthology.org/2025.emnlp-main.1786/), [official repo](https://github.com/microsoft/SimulatorArena).
